description:
We are the very first online guestbook experience for all events!

About our brand and products:
The Social Aisle creates personalised virtual/online guest books for life's most meaningful moments. Couples, families and event hosts share a unique link so loved ones anywhere in the world can record a heartfelt video message, written note, or voice memory — all saved in a private gallery to keep forever. Perfect for weddings, celebrations, memorials, baby arrivals and corporate events.

What makes us different:
Unlike generic video tools, every page is fully themed to the occasion — from romantic wedding pages to elegant corporate events. There's no app to download, no tech skills required, and messages are delivered instantly. It's the most thoughtful gift a guest can give when they can't be there in person.

How affiliates can earn:
Earn 15% commission on every sale you refer. With products ranging from $89–$229 AUD, that's up to $34 per booking — just for sharing your unique code with your clients. Commissions are paid monthly with no minimum threshold.

How to promote us:
Share your unique discount code with couples during consultations, in your client welcome packs, via email, or on social media. We provide ready-made caption templates and graphics to make it effortless. Most affiliates see conversions simply by mentioning it at the right moment — when a client mentions guests travelling from overseas.

Other information:
We work with wedding photographers, planners, celebrants, florists, venues and makeup artists across Australia and internationally. Your clients get 10% off their first order with your code, and you earn every time they buy. Join a growing community of wedding professionals who are adding real value for their couples while earning passive income.

AFFILIATE PROGRAM TERMS & CONDITIONS

Welcome to The Social Aisle! Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program. We're so glad to have you on board.

These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals accessing or using the Program both as a merchant ("we" or "The Social Aisle") and an affiliate ("you" or "affiliate") who refers customers to our products and services.

By participating in the Program, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions in their entirety. If you do not agree, you are not authorised to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. APPROVAL OR REJECTION OF REGISTRATION

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your application.

To be eligible you must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Have a valid payment account for receiving commissions
  • Operate a legitimate business, blog, social media account or website
  • Not be an employee, director or immediate family member of The Social Aisle

2. AFFILIATE LINKS AND COUPON CODES

Your affiliate link is automatically generated upon approval. You may also generate links for specific products or collections via your dashboard.

If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recent click takes priority — yours will count if it is the last link clicked before purchase.

You may or may not be assigned a unique coupon code — details will be shown in your dashboard. If a customer both clicks your affiliate link and uses your coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you have not been assigned a coupon code, you are not permitted to promote one.

You may promote The Social Aisle across online channels including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, email newsletters, blogs and offline channels such as print media, magazines and client welcome packs.

3. COMMISSIONS AND PAYMENT

You will earn a 15% commission on the net order value (excluding GST, shipping and any discounts applied) for every qualifying purchase referred through your affiliate link or coupon code.

To receive payment you must provide your payment details in your account Settings. Payment schedule details are available on the Affiliate Guide page. Commissions are paid monthly, with a minimum balance of $20 AUD required before a payout is processed — balances below this threshold roll over to the following month.

Payments are only made for fully completed transactions. We reserve the right to review each referral order under our fair use policy. Commission status is displayed in the Commissions tab; all paid commissions are listed in the Payments tab. Orders that result in chargebacks, cancellations or refunds will not attract a commission.

Affiliates are solely responsible for declaring and paying applicable taxes on commissions received.

4. PROHIBITED ACTIVITIES

The following are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate termination and forfeiture of all unpaid commissions:

  • Self-referrals — purchasing through your own link or code to generate a commission
  • Creating fake orders, accounts or referrals
  • Cookie stuffing or any manipulation of tracking technology
  • Making false, misleading or exaggerated claims about our products
  • Bidding on The Social Aisle branded keywords in paid search without prior written approval
  • Offering additional discounts or cashback on top of your affiliate code without prior written approval
  • Promoting The Social Aisle on illegal, offensive, discriminatory or adult content platforms
  • Misrepresenting yourself as an employee or official representative of The Social Aisle
  • Affiliates may not use Google Ads or any paid search advertising to promote The Social Aisle or drive traffic through their affiliate link without prior written approval from The Social Aisle. Commissions generated through unauthorised paid search traffic may be withheld.

5. MARKETING MATERIALS

We may provide approved promotional media including banners, logos and product imagery through the Marketing Tools tab in your dashboard. You may download these assets or use the HTML embed code to share on your channels.

You are granted a limited, non-exclusive licence to use our brand assets solely for the purpose of promoting the Program. You may not alter or modify our brand assets without prior written approval. All intellectual property remains the sole property of The Social Aisle.

6. NETWORK REFERRALS

If the Network feature is activated in your account, you may invite others to become downline affiliates. If a downline affiliate generates a sale, you may receive a network commission depending on current program settings. To invite others, share your unique network link — anyone who signs up through that link becomes your downline affiliate.

7. COOKIES AND TRACKING

We use cookies to track customers who click your affiliate link. Customers must have cookies enabled for tracking to work. If a customer clears their cookies or blocks them, we are unable to track the referral and no commission will be payable.

The cookie window is 30 days from the time a customer clicks your affiliate link or uses your coupon code. Any qualifying purchase made within that window will be attributed to you — the customer does not need to click your link again.

8. MODIFICATIONS TO THE PROGRAM

The Social Aisle reserves the right to modify commission rates, cookie durations, payment terms or these Terms and Conditions at any time with 30 days written notice to active affiliates. Continued participation after notice of changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

9. REMOVAL FROM THE PROGRAM

If you wish to leave the Program, contact us at  and we will remove your account promptly. Any accrued commissions on valid completed orders will be paid at the next scheduled payment date.

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any affiliate account at any time if we believe these Terms have been violated or fraudulent activity has occurred.

10. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

The Social Aisle is not liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential losses arising from your participation in the Program. We make no guarantees regarding earning potential. Our total liability shall not exceed the total commissions paid to you in the 3 months preceding any claim.

11. GOVERNING LAW

These Terms are governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia. Any disputes will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of New South Wales.

You made it to the end — thank you! 🎉

We're genuinely excited to have you as part of The Social Aisle community. Go forward and refer — and remember, we're always here if you need support.

📧
